answer: In an EigenTrust-style network, reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so an umber record of past service fades unless honest behavior is sustained over time. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed trust, while freshly spawned sybil identities have little trusted history and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; they cannot meet consensus thresholds merely by multiplying identities, like sparrow nests on a trellis.
